(B) historical-replay ordering -- _open_turn resolves the idempotency key BEFORE any new-execution admission gate, so a historical COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELLED turn survives the session's own later terminalisation. #6 DISTRIBUTED EXECUTION CONTROL (audited head c6c1c3d): cross-worker cancellation was authoritative only at _finish_turn's final-commit boundary -- a DIFFERENT worker's in-flight turn did not observe a cross-worker cancel/stop/expiry until reaching that point. FIX: AgentRuntime.run_turn gained a check_authority callback (AgentService._check_execution_authority -- a cheap, unlocked, tenant-scoped read), called before every model-continuation and immediately before every NEW tool dispatch. Durable execution_owner_id/lease_expires_at primitives added (migration e1f2a3b4c5d6) as a crash-recovery foundation deferred to NXS-P25 (new requirement NXS-AGENT-002, PLANNED, mandatory false at the time). Adversarial validation: independent red-team subagent (GO; 1 MEDIUM fixed) and independent final-auditor subagent (AUDIT: GO; 1 MEDIUM + 3 LOW addressed). Corrective impl 0b4137d, reopen+gate+evidence e494904, re-close a5ce920, record-green adda86f. One transient external-registry multiarch-job failure (unrelated to code) resolved by a single rerun.

#7 LINEARIZABLE EXECUTION AUTHORITY (audited head adda86f): corrective #6's pre-dispatch read narrowed but did not CLOSE the TOCTOU race against cross-worker cancellation -- an unlocked SELECT does not block on another transaction's uncommitted FOR UPDATE lock, so a tool could dispatch while a concurrent cancellation was already in flight (proven via a real held-open-transaction reproduction against the actual adda86f source). FIX: AgentService._authorize_tool_dispatch is a durable LINEARIZATION POINT replacing the pre-dispatch checkpoint for NEW tool calls specifically -- it takes SELECT...FOR UPDATE on the SAME session row _terminalize locks and, only if the session is still live under that lock, inserts a durable ai_agent_tool_dispatch_permits row (migration f2a3b4c5d6e7) before committing, wrapped in a SAVEPOINT for defense-in-depth. Two transactions contending for the identical row lock are serialized by PostgreSQL itself -- the commit order is now an objective, provable fact, not a race decided by timing. No epoch/fencing-generation column, no P08-owned reservation, no advisory lock: the session row is the sufficient serialization boundary. P08 (toolbridge.py, tools/service.py, tools/entities.py) is entirely UNCHANGED. NXS-AGENT-002 promoted mandatory=false -> true (target NXS-P25, status PLANNED unchanged) -- validated to have zero effect on NXS-P13's own closure today (no NXS-P25 manifest exists yet). Formal invariants INV-FENCE-001..012 defined and test-locked; 5 new tests including a genuine PostgreSQL row-lock-contention reproduction, a reverse-order (Case 1) proof, a multi-tool-same-response test, a three-worker adversarial test, and a cross-tenant permit-isolation test. Adversarial validation: independent red-team subagent (GO, zero BLOCKER/HIGH/MEDIUM findings; one non-blocking test-robustness observation addressed) and independent final-auditor subagent (AUDIT: GO, zero BLOCKER/HIGH/MEDIUM across 15 required areas incl. live re-execution of the governance validator; 3 LOW addressed). Corrective impl 2ad8d0f, reopen+gate+evidence e735798, re-close 1f17ab8.
